player_intro: (DeckTech handle '''Gen''') posted a [[Dark]] list on DeckTech in August 2001.
cards: Darth Vader, Dark Lord Of The Sith
shields_note: The post names no Defensive Shields.
notes: The title says the deck took 4th place at the Vancouver Open; the strategy says it is 'card-for-card what I played at Vancouver, before Coruscant was tourney legal' and that it 'went 3-0 in Vancouver'.

Format Premiere - Tatooine: the list is the pre-Coruscant Vancouver list and has no Coruscant-set cards. The post's suggested post-Coruscant changes (-1 Darth Maul, -Teemto's Podracer, +Darth Maul, Sith Apprentice, +They're Still Coming Through; the review response also mentions P-59, We Must Accelerate Our Plans and Maul's ship) are not part of the list.

Cards marked (S) as posted: Tatooine: Desert Landing Site, Tatooine: Jabba's Palace and Combat Readiness. No Objective; Desert Landing Site is the starting location and Combat Readiness (starting) pulls the related battleground site Tatooine: Jabba's Palace. All count toward the total.
Total is 59 as published: the Characters header says 18, but 17 characters are listed.

Posted 'Jabba's PalaceAudience Chamber' dested the Dark Jabba's Palace: Audience Chamber (Dark) (the plain page is Light); Sense and Alter are posted without a set and dested the Dark Premiere printings (the Coruscant printings were not yet legal).

Posted 'Darth Vader, DLOTS' dested Darth Vader, Dark Lord Of The Sith; 'EPP Vader' Darth Vader With Lightsaber; 'EPP Fett' Boba Fett With Blaster Rifle; 'ECC Iggy' IG-88 With Riot Gun; 'ECC 4-Lom' 4-LOM With Concussion Rifle; 'Mara Jade TEH' Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand; 'Prince Xixor' Prince Xizor; 'Dr.E & Ponda Baba' Dr. Evazan & Ponda Baba; 'Darth Maul (Tat)' Darth Maul.

Posted 'Maul's Saber' dested Maul's Lightsaber; 'Mara's Saber' Mara Jade's Lightsaber; 'Vader's Saber' Vader's Lightsaber; 'Iggy in Ship' IG-88 In IG-2000; 'Zuckuss in Ship' Zuckuss In Mist Hunter; 'Bossk in Ship' Bossk In Hound's Tooth; 'Teemto's Pod' Teemto Pagalies' Podracer.

Posted 'YCHF' dested You Cannot Hide Forever; 'Secret Plans' the Special Edition Effect; 'Weapon Lev.' Weapon Levitation; 'Jabba's Through w/You' Jabba's Through With You; 'Omni Box & It's Worse' Ommni Box & It's Worse.
